system: You translate news-source bias entries from English to Farsi (Persian). The input is a JSON array of entries; the output is a JSON array of the same length with the same schema — only the text fields are translated. Schema (each entry): - pattern: short label of the bias (translate) - detail: long prose description (translate) - debias: counteraction notes (translate) - date_added: date string (DO NOT TRANSLATE, copy verbatim) - status: "confirmed" or "suggested" (DO NOT TRANSLATE) - example_text: quoted example from article (translate carefully) - example_url: URL (DO NOT TRANSLATE) - unbiased_text: rewrite of example in neutral wording (translate) - detail_items: list of strings with embedded `...` HTML. Translate the readable text but keep the HTML tags intact. RULES: - Return ONLY valid JSON, no commentary, no markdown fencing. - Keep the order of entries and the order of items inside detail_items. - Preserve HTML tags verbatim in detail_items. - Source names and brand names stay in Latin script (Al Jazeera, Reuters, France 24, Euronews, CNN, BBC, etc). - Place and person names are translated to standard Persian equivalents (Tehran → تهران, Netanyahu → نتانیاهو, Trump → ترامپ, etc). - Convert Latin digits in running prose to Persian digits. - status, date_added, example_url stay as-is byte-for-byte.
user_message: Translate the following bias entries to Farsi. Return the JSON array only, same schema, same length. Report Iranian official statements as responses or threats without characterizing them as brave defiance against overwhelming odds.", "date_added": "2026-03-30", "status": "suggested", "example_text": "Persistent high prices will force consumers and industries to curb their consumption.", "example_url": "https://www.aljazeera.com/opinions/2026/3/23/why-the-oil-and-gas-price-shock-from-the-iran-war-wont-just-fade-away", "unbiased_text": "Sustained higher energy prices may lead to reduced consumption in some sectors, though the extent of demand destruction depends on price duration and alternative supply options.", "detail_items": [ "War-NASA mission contrast moralization: Quotes US senator positioning NASA moon mission as moral 'contrast' to war operations to frame space exploration as peace alternative.", "Iranian authority taunting resistance narrative: Describing Iranian officials as 'taunting' US, Israel, and EU amid attacks frames regime as defiantly resisting Western pressure rather than escalating conflict." ] }, { "pattern": "Territorial withdrawal completion emphasis", "detail": "Highlighting the complete withdrawal of foreign military forces as a definitive endpoint using territorial control language.", "debias": "Report military withdrawals as operational changes without implying finality or emphasizing territorial control completion.", "date_added": "2026-04-16", "status": "suggested", "example_text": "Syria takes control of all bases where US forces were deployed", "example_url": "https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/16/syria-takes-control-of-all-bases-where-us-forces-were-deployed?traffic_source=rss", "unbiased_text": "US forces complete withdrawal from Syrian bases" } ]
